title: mris_surface_stats
description: Computes the group-wise mean and standard deviation of thickness differences at every vertex of the template surface.

std_output.description: Standard deviation map of the input thickness difference maps

mean_output.description: Mean map of the input thickness difference maps

absmean_output.description: Absolute mean map of the input thickness difference maps

absstd_output.description: Standard deviation map of the absolute differences

zscore_output.description: Z-score map of the input thickness difference maps
